 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut POLITICS 
 Election Day 2026: Voting hours, how to report poll problems and more 
 Monday, November 2, 2026 7:39PM 
 Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7 NEW YORK (WABC) -- The 2026 midterm elections take place Tuesday and if you are voting in New York, New Jersey or Connecticut, this is what to know before heading to the polls.
 NEW YORK CITY
 Polls are open from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m.
 Click here to find your poll site and wait time.
 If you have a question or complaint, click here for the Election Hotline Complaint Form.
 Having issues accessing the form? Click here for a reference guide.
 NEW YORK
 Polls are open from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m.
 Click here to find your election day poll site.
 If you have a question or complaint, click here for the Election Hotline Complaint Form.
 Having issues accessing the form? Click here for a reference guide.
 NEW JERSEY
 Polls are open from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.
 Click here to find your election day poll site.
 Have a question or a problem voting? Call the Voter Information and Assistance line at 1-877-658-6837.
 If you have been a victim to discrimination or harassment while exercising your right to vote, You can file a report with the New Jersey Division on Civil Rights here or call 1-833-653-2748.
 CONNECTICUT
 Polls are open from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.
 Click here to check your registration and find your election day poll site.
